AN ORIGINAL JURASSIC ENGLISH STORY

Mina and the Midnight Drum

Level 1 · Foundation

Ages 4–8

Story + Workbook

JurassicEnglish.com · Storybook workbook edition

Chapter 1

The big drum

1

Mina has a small drum.
BOOM! Her aunt plays the big drum.
It is the Midnight Drum. It will play at the town party.
Mina smiles. ‘Can I play?’
Read and circle

Who plays the big drum first?
A. Mina
B. Her aunt
C. Sami
